title: Not a quality product
text: Not a quality product. I bought these for a centerpiece. The trees are VERY small. It wouldn’t be possible to place small ornaments on them (not even the baby ones for small trees). They also didn’t stand up evenly in the box. Returned all 10 of them. The company was very nice and provided a full refund. I bought a single larger “mini tree” for the centerpiece and it worked out great.

product_metadata.title: Winlyn 3 Pack Mini Canadian Pine Trees with Wood Bases Artificial Miniature Christmas Trees and Rustic Planter for Holiday Season Tabletop Decoration Centerpiece Displays
features: Quantity: Package include Trio of Artificial Pine Trees and Rustic Planter. The mini Christmas trees have enough needles, 32 to 60 tips, making them easy to be shaped and fluffed out.

Dimension: The Mini Canadian Pine Trees are available in 3 sizes, 7.5" (small), 8.9" (medium), 10.8" (large), measuring from the bottom of the wood base all the way to the very top of the top branch. Wood planter box is appr. 13.1" long, 3.9" wide and 1.7" tall, perfect for holding the potted plants.
Created with detail in mind, each tree features wired faux pine branches. Don't forget to fluff! Simply start at the top and work in a spiral motion down each tree to create the desired full effect.
Get your home ready for the holiday season with this Trio of Artificial Pine Trees and Rustic Planter!
description: When your living space won't accommodate a grand display, deck these tabletop trees out with small ornaments, lights, and a tree topper. Combine them with vintage Christmas baubles to create a farmhouse vignette for the holiday season. Display the trees and crate all together or separately to suit your needs!
